body:
## Symptom

After the 0.38.0 MT-only release, MT sensors stopped reading entirely. HA logs (via Loki, `service_name=homeassistant`) show this every ~30s:

```
ERROR [custom_components.meraki_dashboard.utils.error_handling] API error in async_get_sensor_data: Unexpected gateway connections response: <class 'dict'>
```

## Root cause

The MT-only refactor (a820159) added a `getOrganizationSensorGatewaysConnectionsLatest` call for per-sensor RSSI + last-seen diagnostics. Unlike `getOrganizationSensorReadingsLatest` (which returns a bare **list**), the gateways/connections/latest endpoint returns the newer Meraki paginated envelope `{"items": [...], "meta": {...}}` — a **dict**. The SDK's legacy paginator (`_get_pages_legacy`, the default) returns that dict verbatim.

`organization.py:async_get_all_gateway_connections` did `if not isinstance(rows, list): raise MerakiApiError(...)`, so it raised every cycle. Because that call was awaited **inline** inside `network.py:async_get_sensor_data` — which is wrapped by `@handle_api_errors` that returns an empty dict on error — the exception wiped out **all** MT readings on every refresh.

The reference meraki-dashboard-exporter avoided this because it runs gateway-connections as a separate collector with its own try/except (degrades gracefully); the inline HA call did not.

Tests missed it because `test_gateway_connections_parse` mocked a bare list, not the real `{items,meta}` envelope.

## Fix

- [x] Unwrap `rows = rows["items"]` when the response is a dict with an `items` key (a dict *without* `items` is the SDK exhausted-retry `{"errors":[...]}` shape → still raise, to keep prior entity state)
- [x] Defense-in-depth: wrap the gateway-connections call in `async_get_sensor_data` in try/except so a diagnostic-only failure can never nuke primary readings again
- [x] Add regression tests: `{items,meta}` envelope parses; readings survive a gateway-connections failure

## Note (separate, not this bug)

Logs also show `mt_refresh_service ... Action batch failed with status 400: A suitable gateway was not available for sending this command`. That's the MT15/MT40 force-refresh command needing an online gateway; it retries and does not stop readings. Tracked separately if it needs quieting.

comments.body:
Fixed in ac76e8a (pushed to main).

- `organization.py` now unwraps the `{items, meta}` envelope before validating; a dict without `items` (the exhausted-retry `{errors:[...]}` shape) still raises so prior entity state is kept.
- `network.py` wraps the diagnostic gateway-connections fetch in try/except so it can never wipe primary readings again.
- Regression tests added for both the envelope shape and readings-survive-failure. Full suite green (683 passed), ruff + mypy clean.

Will land in the next release-please cut.

body:
## Mission

Strip the integration down to **MT (environmental sensor) devices only**, delete all MR/MS/MV support, adopt the Meraki-API-calling learnings from the meraki-dashboard-exporter bugbash, and ship as a **breaking major version (v1.0.0)** with a README/manifest rebrand and an auto-migration + repair notice. MT functionality must not regress.

## Binding decisions (do not re-litigate)

1. **Removal scope = "MT + minimal health"**: delete all MR/MS/MV + license/alert/switch/wireless/bluetooth org diagnostics. KEEP a small org-hub health set: API call success / rate-limit status + MT device count. Org hub stays as internal plumbing.
2. **API refactor = full overhaul**: org-wide single readings call (no per-network `serials=`, `perPage=1000`, `total_pages=all`); gateway-connections endpoint for RSSI/last-seen; org-keyed rate limiting at ~80% budget; disable SDK blocking 429 retry, own one bounded async retry; corrected parsing map; inventory caching; never fabricate 0 on error.
3. **Migration = auto-migrate + repair notice**: config-entry VERSION 2→3; strip non-MT config + stale non-MT (MR/MS/MV model-prefix) registry devices; raise a persistent HA repair issue. Hub devices (no model) must survive.
4. **Rebrand = README + manifest display name only; KEEP `domain=meraki_dashboard`** (no forced reconfigure). Target v1.0.0 via `feat!` / `BREAKING CHANGE`.
5. **Webhooks out of scope.** Keep polling-based MT event tracking; document the button-press limitation only.

## Phases (parallel lanes over disjoint files)

- [ ] Task 0 — seam freeze + shared test fixtures + tracking issues (main thread)
- [ ] Lane A — pure deletes (camera/switch/mr/ms/mv) + services.yaml + devices/__init__.py
- [ ] Lane B — const/types/config pruning
- [ ] Lane C — Meraki API overhaul (org/network hubs, coordinator, MT parsing, rate limiter)
- [ ] Lane D — entities/factory + minimal-health org sensors + platform trims
- [ ] Lane E — config-entry migration (2→3) + repair issue
- [ ] Lane F — docs/branding/strings + config_flow + diagnostics + device_info
- [ ] Task W — wiring pass (__init__.py) + full lint/test gate + v1.0.0 commit
- [ ] Task C5 (optional) — no2/o3/pm10 air-quality metrics

Plan + spec live in the gitignored `docs/superpowers/` scratch dir. Progress tracked here per phase.

comments.body:
Landed in a820159 (pushed to `main`, closes this epic + #296–#301).

**Delivered:**
- Stripped all MR/MS/MV device support, the switch + camera platforms, the set_camera_rtsp / cycle_switch_port_poe services, and the license/alert/clients/bluetooth/device-status/memory org diagnostics.
- **MT API overhaul:** org-wide single `getOrganizationSensorReadingsLatest` call (no per-network `serials=`, `perPage=1000`, `total_pages=all`; SCALE-13 fix) with a short-TTL org cache and client-side filtering; new `getOrganizationSensorGatewaysConnectionsLatest` fetch for per-sensor RSSI + last-seen entities; SDK built with `wait_on_rate_limit=False, retry_4xx_error=False` + one bounded/cancellable 429 retry; rate limiting at 80% of org budget; corrected parsing map; never fabricate 0 on error/429.
- Kept a minimal org-hub health set (API-call / rate-limit status + MT device count).
- **Migration:** config entry v2→v3 auto-strips non-MT config + stale MR/MS/MV registry devices (positive model-prefix predicate; hub devices preserved) and raises a persistent `mt_only_migration` repair notice.
- **Rebrand:** manifest name → "Meraki MT Sensors" (domain unchanged, no reconfigure), README breaking-change banner + MT-only docs.

**Gate:** `make lint` clean (ruff + mypy 40 files + bandit), full suite **678 passed** at 82% coverage. release-please will cut **v1.0.0** from the `feat!`/`BREAKING CHANGE` commit.

body:
Part of the fleet-wide docs effort tracked in **rknightion/m7kni-net-site#28** (Phase 2). This repo's doc site is served under the m7kni.io hub at `/meraki-dashboard-ha/`, so its own Zensical build + theme overrides determine what search engines and LLMs see for these pages.

Two things are bundled here because they touch the same files:

1. **Redesign & rebrand alignment** — adopt the new m7kni.io brand and colour scheme (light-first, the shared wordmark / palette / type tokens) so the whole fleet reads as one product family. **Tune it for documentation, not marketing:** unlike the vibrant hub *landing* page, these are end-user **product documentation** sites — prioritise a clean, professional, highly readable, documentation-friendly presentation (sensible density, strong nav/TOC/search, scannable reference content) while staying on-brand in palette, type, and logo. Brand-consistent, docs-first. The exact spec follows from the hub redesign — treat the visual details as **pending finalization in rknightion/m7kni-net-site#28** and don't front-run them.
2. **SEO / LLM discoverability** — the metadata improvements below, fully specified now and able to proceed independently of the visual spec.

## Why (SEO/LLM part)

Like the hub, this site's `docs/overrides/main.html` is an empty passthrough, so OpenGraph/Twitter/JSON-LD/robots meta are either absent or (if copied from the hub) injected client-side and invisible to non-JS crawlers and LLMs (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, social unfurlers). Render them server-side.

## Tasks

- [ ] **Redesign & rebrand alignment** — apply the finalized hub brand/scheme in a professional, documentation-friendly way (spec via rknightion/m7kni-net-site#28). Brand-consistent palette/type/logo; docs-first layout, density, and navigation.
- [ ] **Server-render head tags** — `main.html` `extrahead` override emitting canonical, `theme-color`, OpenGraph, Twitter (`summary_large_image`), and `robots` meta server-side, reading `config.extra.*` + `page.meta.*`. Mirror the hub's implementation once #29 lands (reuse the same override pattern). ⚠️ MiniJinja — no Python string methods.
- [ ] **JSON-LD** — per-page `Article` (not `TechArticle`) + a repo-level `SoftwareSourceCode`/`SoftwareApplication` node (name, description, `programmingLanguage`, `codeRepository` → this GitHub repo). `Organization` site-wide.
- [ ] **Remove any client-side `seo.js`** if this repo carries a copy; server-side supersedes it.
- [ ] **GEO content-shape pass** on the docs prose (biggest evidence-backed LLM-citation win): definition-first sentences (lead a config option with what it does), self-contained/chunkable `##`/`###` sections (restate the subject, don't rely on "it"/"this"), config/flag/env reference as **tables** not prose, language-tagged code fences (```yaml/```bash), strict one-H1-per-page hierarchy.
- [ ] **robots.txt** — ensure this repo's `docs/robots.txt` allows the current AI UAs (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `CCBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Meta-ExternalAgent`, plus user-action bots). (Note: the hub regenerates per-site `robots.txt` at merge time — keep the source consistent with the hub's policy.)
- [ ] **Align zensical version** — match the fleet's pinned zensical version and Renovate handling as decided in Phase 1 (rknightion/m7kni-net-site#29). Depending on that decision this repo may drop zensical from its own CI entirely (if the hub build is the only consumer) or keep it pinned + Renovate-grouped for local/preview builds — follow the fleet approach from #29, don't invent a per-repo variant.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Site is on-brand with the new m7kni.io scheme while reading as a clean, professional product-documentation site.
- [ ] `curl` of a deployed page under m7kni.io/meraki-dashboard-ha/ (no JS) shows server-rendered OG/Twitter/canonical/JSON-LD/robots meta.
- [ ] Docs pages follow the GEO content-shape checklist above.
- [ ] zensical version handling matches the fleet decision in #29.
- [ ] Site build green; renders correctly under the hub.

## Notes

- llms.txt / llms-full.txt / sitemaps for this site are generated centrally by the hub's scripts over this repo's Markdown — **not** per-repo work here.
- Do the SEO/LLM + version tasks whenever useful; gate only the visual-redesign task on the hub spec.
title: Docs site: redesign & rebrand alignment + SEO/LLM discoverability
